content: 1. Enasidenib increases the systemic levels or effects of triclabendazole by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. Close monitoring is required. Due to increased systemic exposure to triclabendazole, ECG monitoring is recommended to assess potential QT prolongation. 2. Both triclabendazole and encorafenib prolong the QTc interval.
